statement0:
The word "also" is mentioned two or more times in 48.4% of psychology papers' Results sections, as of 2020-2024.

Among 2020-2024 papers containing "also" , 25.8% of significant p-values (p < .05) are fragile (.01 ≤ p < .05) – i.e., barely fall under the standard significance threshold. This is a lower than the typical psychology paper (median shown for reference). Relative to other words, "also" papers are in the bottom 37th percentile in terms of fragile p-value percentage (lower = better). Note, p-values highly predict replicability (see the associated paper).
statement1: As of 2020-2024, papers containing "also" tend to be published in lower impact factor journals (40th percentile among all words) and tend to be cited less (50th percentile word). In general, this word is negatively associated with university ranking, such that higher-ranked institutions are less likely to publish papers containing "also" (37th percentile).
